post.originalText:
Google just opened Gemini 4 Argon. Same prompt as Opus 5.5, Muse and GLM: 1,000+ drones over the Seine, finale "CHEZ DOM". One shot.

1. Argon: cleanest. $0.65*, 7 min
2. Opus: most cinematic. $16.57, 91 min
3. Muse: gold arch in the way
4. GLM: lost finale

*launch price https://t.co/7DDGWA84En
